test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: At what rate per annum of simple interest will a sum of ₹7,500 become ₹9,250 in 7 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹7,500

Amount (A) = ₹9,250

Time (T) = 7 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = A - P

Rate (R) = (SI × 100) / (P × T)

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹9,250 - ₹7,500

SI = ₹1,750

Rate (R) = (₹1,750 × 100) / (₹7,500 × 7)

Rate (R) = (1,75,000) / (52,500)

Rate (R) = 3¹⁄₃%

**The rate per annum of simple interest is 3¹⁄₃%.**
